clusters.headline: Security Forces Neutralize Lashkar-e-Taiba Commander Lateef Bhat
aiSummaryBullets: Security forces killed Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist Lateef Bhat in Kulgam following an eight-day search operation.
Bhat was identified by authorities as a key suspect in a November 11 attack that resulted in injuries to three CRPF personnel.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Remains In Very Poor To Severe Categories
aiSummaryBullets: Most monitoring stations in Delhi continue to record air quality levels classified as very poor or severe.
Specific locations including IIT-Delhi have reported air quality index readings exceeding 400.

clusters.headline: Prime Minister Modi Addresses Quad And ASEAN Summits In Manila
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Modi emphasized the importance of cooperation and stability during discussions at the ASEAN-India summit.
During the Quad meeting, the Prime Minister advocated for concrete goals to strengthen security in the Indo-Pacific region.

clusters.headline: Indian Government Updates Supreme Court On Air India Crash Probe
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities notified the Supreme Court that the official investigation into the 2025 flight crash is nearing completion.
The inquiry is being conducted by the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau.

clusters.headline: Diverse Administrative And Political Developments In Tamil Nadu
aiSummaryBullets: A publisher was arrested for allegedly supplying thousands of bogus AI-generated books to state libraries.
Health authorities opened a new Centre for Advanced Genomics in Ranipet to enhance genetic testing capabilities.

clusters.headline: Mahendra Singh Dhoni Transitions To Mentor Role After IPL Career
aiSummaryBullets: Mahendra Singh Dhoni has officially concluded his 17-season IPL playing career with the Chennai Super Kings.
The franchise has appointed the former captain as their team mentor for the upcoming 2027 IPL season.

clusters.headline: Three Central Reserve Police Force Personnel Injured In Kulgam Attack
aiSummaryBullets: Three security personnel sustained injuries following an armed assault in the Kulgam district of Jammu and Kashmir.
The attackers, identified as two individuals on a motorcycle, opened fire on a security checkpost near Mir Bazar on Wednesday.

clusters.headline: Allahabad High Court Grants Interim Bail To Leader Azam Khan
aiSummaryBullets: The Allahabad High Court ordered interim bail for Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan in a money laundering case.
The Enforcement Directorate had previously detained Khan following investigations into land acquisition allegations linked to Jauhar University.

clusters.headline: BJP Criticizes Rahul Gandhi Over Remarks On India’s Economy In US
aiSummaryBullets: Rahul Gandhi described India as facing an impending economic disaster and high unemployment during a talk at Columbia University.
BJP officials rejected these claims, characterizing the comments as anti-India propaganda.

clusters.headline: Recent Kerala High Court Rulings On Legal And Administrative Issues
aiSummaryBullets: The Kerala High Court expressed concerns regarding delayed financial audits at the Guruvayur Devaswom Board.
Judges clarified that repaying a loan does not absolve an individual of charges filed under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act.

clusters.headline: India Secures Under-19 Asia Cup Title Amidst On-Field Controversy
aiSummaryBullets: India secured a narrow one-wicket victory against Pakistan in the Under-19 Asia Cup final while chasing 337 runs.
Aaryavir Sehwag finished the tournament as the leading scorer after his match-winning performance in the final.

clusters.headline: Indian Ministry Of Defence Finalizes INS Betwa Propulsion Upgrade
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian Defence Ministry has awarded a 498 crore rupee contract for the refit of the frigate INS Betwa.
The project involves replacing the vessel's current steam-based propulsion with a diesel engine-based system.

clusters.headline: Donald Trump Proposes Tim Cook As Successor To Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
aiSummaryBullets: Jensen Huang has stepped down from his position as the CEO of Nvidia.
The board of Nvidia has appointed Colette Kress to serve as interim chief executive officer.

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Memoir Sparks Political Debate And Personal Revelations
aiSummaryBullets: The memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love provides insights into historical political moments, including the 1969 Presidential elections and the 1999 Congress revolt.
Personal anecdotes in the book range from Sonia Gandhi's 1978 visit to Indira Gandhi in Tihar Jail to her reflections on interactions with Pranab Mukherjee.

clusters.headline: Election Commission Updates Draft Voter Rolls Across Indian States
aiSummaryBullets: Draft voter lists across 13 states and union territories show a recovery to nearly 46 crore voters after a prior reduction.
Uttar Pradesh has added 18 lakh voters to its rolls, reaching a total of 13.58 crore, amid political inquiries regarding list composition.

clusters.headline: India Secures Tenth SAFF Championship Title After Victory In Dhaka
aiSummaryBullets: India defeated Pakistan with a 2-1 score in the SAFF Championship final held in Dhaka.
The victory marks the tenth title for India and their third consecutive win in the tournament.

clusters.headline: Passenger Injured By Thrown Knife During Mumbai Local Train Brawl
aiSummaryBullets: A 53-year-old man sustained a chest injury when a knife thrown during an altercation on a Virar-Churchgate train hit him.
The incident occurred on November 15 near Andheri station while two other individuals were reportedly fighting.

clusters.headline: Sonam Wangchuk Placed Under House Arrest Amid Ladakh Poll Protests
aiSummaryBullets: Activist Sonam Wangchuk stated he is under house arrest following his removal from a protest site by local police.
Civil society groups are demanding the postponement of Ladakh's hill council elections, citing the harsh winter conditions.

clusters.headline: India Joins Global Coalition To Secure Artificial Intelligence Supply
aiSummaryBullets: India joined a ten-nation coalition led by the United States to secure artificial intelligence supply chains against competition from China.
The European Union imposed anti-dumping duties on steel exports arriving from India and four other nations.

clusters.headline: AIMIM And Azad Samaj Party Form Alliance For Uttar Pradesh Elections
aiSummaryBullets: Asaduddin Owaisi and Chandrashekhar Azad have launched the Samajik Parivartan Morcha to contest the Uttar Pradesh elections.
The alliance seeks to mobilize Dalit, Muslim, and backward community voters.
